description: Measures DUT current via PPK2 while running a DTM receiver test, with an optional companion transmitter on a second serial port.
help_text:
📡 [PPK2 DTM RX Current Guide]

1. Setup: Configure Target DUT Control Port in top toolbar (19200 bps), place PPK2 Interface Config on dashboard, then run this card
2. DTM Channel: Both sides must use the same channel
3. Companion Port (Optional): A second DTM device on this host, transmitting so the DUT receives. Leave empty to measure listening current only.
4. Min Packets: Proves the RF link worked - checked only when companion transmitter is specified
5. Verdict: Current limit is compared against the average, not the peak
name: DTM RX Current Measurement Using PPK2
